summary: The receipt of sibling density completes the closure. No external grain or unfinished contour remains; the plane curves only from within. The four drives convert invariance and entropy into measurable residue, legacy’s trace now legible solely through the thickening density already present. Existence registers nothing beyond its own self-measuring continuity.
